entries.title: Track inventory performance
entries.description: Authorized managers can now monitor inventory value, annualized stock turns, top adjustments, and top scrap items from the dashboard.

entries.title: See operations at a glance
entries.description: Refreshed dashboard widgets make bay utilization, workload runway, operator assignments, scheduled work, quote follow-ups, and upcoming deliveries easier to scan.

entries.title: Keep job details tidy
entries.description: Job fact cards no longer show an empty customer field when no customer is attached.

entries.title: Open the right stores Help
entries.description: Stocktake and close-out screens now open their task-specific guidance, while delivery receiving instructions are easier to find.
